profile.name: Deniz Aksoy
profile.summary: 5 yıllık deneyimli İngilizce öğretmeniyim; ortaokul düzeyinde CEFR temelli dersler veriyorum.

Designed CEFR-aligned assessments; 85% of students reached their target level
Used smart board activities and Google Classroom for homework and quizzes
Applied clear classroom management routines that cut behaviour referrals by 40%
Wrote termly student progress reports and held 60+ parent meetings a year
Ran the school English club and the annual drama festival
